cohort: 6,094 births at an urban academic medical center from 2017 to 2019
finding: Antepartum depressive symptoms were associated with significant postpartum inpatient opioid use, particularly following cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The association between antepartum depressive symptoms and significant postpartum opioid use was stronger for cesarean births (adjusted risk ratio 1.8; 95% CI, 1.1-2.7) compared to vaginal births, where the association was not significant.
